messages:
kai: alert: untagged GPU spend detected in APAC ephemeral pool during autoscale window. Rough amount: $7,320. Putting data here for quick triage.

marta: link to export: https://redwood.internal/costs/apac/3187654321-ephemeral-export.csv. Looks like label attach failed on node join hook.

liam: quick heuristic split I ran: Recommendation -> Ads-ML $3,900; Realtime $2,200; Experiments $1,220. Will need approvals to rebill.

zoe (product): need product lead ok for any > $1k to Experiments and >$2k to Realtime. cc @amy-ads for Ads signoff.

amy-ads (via DM): Ok for Ads to take $3.9k.

liam: created ticket FIN-2026-102 "APAC ephemeral pool untagged spend - rebill 3187654321". Proposed ledger: LDG-CORE-APAC. cost_centers: CC-ADS, CC-RT, CC-RND.

ledger-bot: Please confirm ledger and cost_center strings before JE creation.

eng-infra-bot: FYI pushing hotfix to re-run tag attach on node join; will also add alert if unlabeled > $1k in 30m window. Deployed to staging, rolling to prod in 15m.

marta: approvals inline: Ads ok, Realtime product lead @sam-rt approved via :thumbsup: in convo, Experiments lead @devon approved.

liam: running rebill script now, preview:
```
ads-ml,3900,LDG-CORE-APAC,CC-ADS
realtime,2200,LDG-CORE-APAC,CC-RT
experiments,1220,LDG-CORE-APAC,CC-RND
```

ledger-bot: JE created JE-2026-APAC-3187654321 attached to FIN-2026-102: https://redwood.internal/journal/JE-2026-APAC-3187654321.csv

zoe (product): noted. Please include audit comment in JE: "Reallocation due to node-join tag attach failure during autoscaler churn; heuristic allocation used; owners approved in slack thread."

liam: done. Closing ticket after attaching JE and CSV. Follow-up: eng to confirm alert firing and close remediation PR.
notes: Heuristic rebill executed for APAC ephemeral pool tag-loss; JE and JIRA created; engineering hotfix deployed and follow-up alert configured.
